centralized.name: B1 - Centralized Detector
centralized.description: All data transmitted to cloud for processing with HEAVY model (LSTM Autoencoder)

static_edge.name: B2 - Static Edge Detector
static_edge.description: Local processing with fixed STANDARD model (Autoencoder)

adaptive_edge.name: B3 - Proposed Adaptive Edge Detector
adaptive_edge.description: Local processing with adaptive controller selecting between LIGHT/STANDARD/HEAVY models

controller.adaptive_behavior: Controller made resource-aware decisions, falling back to STANDARD mode due to resource constraints

edge_vs_centralized_latency_reduction.note: Latency reduction due to network elimination (architectural advantage, not algorithmic)

edge_vs_centralized_data_reduction.note: Data reduction due to local processing (architectural advantage)

adaptive_vs_static_cpu.note: Adaptive has higher CPU due to controller overhead and resource monitoring

detection_comparison.note: Edge methods achieve better F1 due to better precision

methodology_notes.threshold_calibration: All three systems use validation-based threshold calibration (F1 optimization) to prevent test-set leakage
methodology_notes.cpu_measurement: Centralized baseline now uses actual CPU measurement (not hardcoded 0.0)
methodology_notes.latency_measurement: Centralized includes network latency (uplink + downlink + inference), Edge systems measure local inference only
methodology_notes.communication: Edge systems transmit only anomaly events (30,720 bytes), Centralized transmits all data (331,680 bytes)
methodology_notes.adaptive_behavior: Adaptive controller makes resource-aware decisions but falls back to STANDARD mode under current resource constraints

limitations.dataset: Synthetic data may not reflect real-world performance
limitations.adaptive_tuning: Controller weights/thresholds may need domain-specific calibration for better model switching
limitations.single_run: Results from single run; multiple runs with statistical reporting recommended for production
limitations.detection_performance: All methods have low F1 scores (<0.2), indicating challenging detection task or need for model improvement
